name: budget-guard
description: Stops a session before it runs past a budget. Three figures are guarded, each with a limit you set: the session cost in dollars, the 5-hour plan window and the 7-day plan window. It says nothing until a figure nears its limit, then pins a status line and warns once; past the limit it refuses tool calls and asks before sending another prompt. /guard shows the state and changes the limits.

costLimitUsd.title: Session cost limit (USD)
costLimitUsd.description: Dollars this session may spend before the guard acts. 0 turns the cost guard off.

fiveHourLimitPercent.title: 5-hour window limit (%)
fiveHourLimitPercent.description: Percent of the 5-hour plan window the guard allows. 0 turns this guard off.

sevenDayLimitPercent.title: 7-day window limit (%)
sevenDayLimitPercent.description: Percent of the 7-day plan window the guard allows. 0 turns this guard off.

warnAtPercent.title: Warn at (% of a limit)
warnAtPercent.description: How far along a limit a figure has to be before the guard warns about it.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: block refuses tool calls once a limit is passed. warn only says so.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the whole guard off without uninstalling it.
